title: Pleats in Play
category: Remake — Tommy Jeans Pleated Tennis Skirt
concept: A court classic, reimagined in digital form.
description: A digital recreation of a Tommy Jeans tennis-inspired pleated skirt, combining sporty details with precise garment construction. Developed in CLO 3D, the design features a branded elastic waistband, a smooth fitted yoke, and crisp, evenly spaced pleats. A white cotton-poplin-inspired fabric captures the balance between lightweight structure and natural movement.

construction.fit: Fitted at the waist and upper hips, transitioning into a short, flared silhouette.
construction.collar: Not applicable — wide branded elastic waistband with navy stripe detailing.
construction.pockets: No visible pockets, maintaining a clean and streamlined silhouette.
construction.seams: Clean yoke-to-pleat seam with subtle stitching and a neatly finished hem.
construction.fabric: White cotton-poplin-inspired fabric, potentially blended with polyester, with a fine weave and crisp hand.
construction.volume: Evenly spaced, structured pleats create rhythmic volume and a softly flared shape.
